text: ok great now last thing is what about just purely unreachable code
resolution: Completed a read-only unreachable-code audit of framework/gpu/3d.zig and adjacent 3D/model-editor modules. A conservative source call graph found 9 unreachable top-level functions in 3d.zig and 2 definition-only adjacent functions, plus a legacy face-tint compatibility subsystem whose operational branch is unreachable because its backing map has no current writer. Separated test-only helpers from truly unreachable runtime code and did not modify source files.
